translations.overview: La strana ma vera storia dell'amicizia tra gli attori Greg Sestero e Tommy Wiseau, che insieme realizzarono The Room, un film spesso considerato come il peggiore della storia del cinema.
An aspiring actor in Hollywood meets an enigmatic stranger by the name of Tommy Wiseau, the meeting leads the actor down a path nobody could have predicted; creating the worst movie ever made.
translations.tagline: Based on the true story of one movie so bad it became infamous.
